BasePlanning.contextDescription: Choose the group and general planning intent to get an initial proposal.
BasePlanning.competitionNeutral: The base plan represents the group's general progression. Competitions are managed separately for the relevant audience.
BasePlanning.horizonDescription: Define the period available to distribute training load.
BasePlanning.horizonInvalid: Enter valid dates in order covering at least 4 weeks.
BasePlanning.loadDescription: Suggested weekly values for {group}. You can adjust them before creating the plan.
BasePlanning.elevationOptional: You can leave both values empty and define them later.
BasePlanning.warnings: There are {count, number} methodological warnings. You can continue if these are deliberate planning decisions.
BasePlanning.errors: Correct the {count, number} errors before continuing.
BasePlanning.draftNotice: Continuing creates a draft group plan with this strategy.
BasePlanning.parseError: The load parameters could not be read.
BasePlanning.invalidError: Check the strategy data before continuing.
BasePlanning.groupUnavailable: The selected group is not available.
BasePlanning.groupMismatch: The selected group does not match the strategy.
BasePlanning.createError: The group plan and its load strategy could not be created.

issues.initial-volume-positive: Initial volume must be greater than 0 km per week.
issues.maximum-volume-positive: Maximum volume must be greater than 0 km per week.
issues.initial-volume-above-maximum: Initial volume cannot exceed the maximum.
issues.initial-volume-outside-group-range: Initial volume is outside the reference range of {min, number}–{max, number} km/week for {group}.
issues.maximum-volume-outside-group-range: Maximum volume is outside the reference range of {min, number}–{max, number} km/week for {group}.
issues.weekly-increase-range: Weekly increase must be greater than 0% and no more than 20%.
issues.weekly-increase-above-reference: The increase exceeds the conservative 10% reference. The coach can retain it as a deliberate planning decision.
issues.deload-range: Deload must be greater than 0% and less than 100%.
issues.initial-elevation-non-negative: Initial elevation gain must be finite and non-negative.
issues.maximum-elevation-non-negative: Maximum elevation gain must be finite and non-negative.
issues.incomplete-elevation-range: Enter both elevation values or leave both empty.
issues.initial-elevation-above-maximum: Initial elevation gain cannot exceed the maximum.
issues.density-high: High vertical density ({density, number} m+/km). Confirm that this is a deliberate mountain objective.
issues.density-extreme: Extreme vertical density ({density, number} m+/km). Check distance and elevation gain.
